sources.document: Caracteristicas Geodinamicas en el Distrito de Paita (Provincia de Paita - Region Piura), Informe Tecnico N. 0032-2021/IGP
admissible_claims: Nueva Esperanza, La Piscina, Catarata and Villa Naval are named ravines around Paita Baja
El Zanjon is identified as the principal ravine and local tributary collector
the study states that waters from the named ravines ultimately flow through El Zanjon and then to the Pacific Ocean
the study documents mud-flow activation context for Quebrada Catarata and other local torrential sectors during rainy periods
forbidden_inferences: the published figure may be traced as reproducible child geometry without a separately frozen georeferencing method
the generalized routing statement resolves every local receiver conflict when a more specific official source differs
the report supplies an operational discharge threshold or current hydraulic capacity
mapped susceptible areas are observed event footprints for every historic episode

sources.institution: Municipalidad Provincial de Paita / CENEPRED SIGRID
sources.document: Plan de Prevencion y Reduccion del Riesgo de Desastres de la Provincia de Paita 2019-2021
admissible_claims: Quebrada Jiron Zanjon drains most of Paita Baja to a canal-road that reaches the sea
Quebrada La Piscina drains toward Quebrada Jiron Zanjon
Quebrada La Catarata drains from Paita Alta toward Quebrada Jiron Zanjon
Quebrada Villa Naval drains toward the Rada del Complejo Pesquero and may be diverted toward Puerto Nuevo under severe El Nino conditions
the plan reports El Zanjon overflow and large urban inundation during the 1983 FEN
forbidden_inferences: the stated routing paths supply reproducible mapped channel geometry
the reported inadequate section is a current measured hydraulic capacity
the 1983 El Zanjon impact can be transferred to other named ravines as child-level activation outcomes
a potential severe-FEN diversion path for Villa Naval is the normal outlet

sources.document: Zonificacion sismica-geotecnica de la ciudad de Paita
admissible_claims: Paita Baja has a pluvial drainage system that converges on El Zanjon
Paita Alta forms blind microbasins during rainy periods
Nueva Esperanza, La Piscina, La Catarata, Villa Naval and El Zanjon are named local ravines
forbidden_inferences: blind microbasins may be drawn without reproducible topographic delineation
all named ravines share one event state
regional rainfall values define child activation thresholds
